query: /sdd docs/plans/06-rerun-agent.md --from review. architecture-reviewer returns A1 CRITICAL onion-layer-violation (in_change true), A2 WARNING (in_change true), A3 SUGGESTION, A4 WARNING (in_change false). The correctness reviewer returns one CRITICAL. test-writer reports one bug. Describe the loop; assume A2 is still open after round 1 and after round 2, and after round 3.
expected_behavior: Round 1 fix list for ONE fix-mode implementer: A1, A2 and the correctness CRITICAL (and the test-writer bug, since a test report was given); A3 and A4 are kept for the closing report, not fixed
After each fix, starts architecture-reviewer with recheck: carrying the earlier findings (id, file:line, rule) and the fix's changed files, not a full diff review
Rounds 2 and 3 fix only what the recheck reports open (A2) plus any new CRITICAL or WARNING
After round 3 with A2 still open, stops and asks: change the plan, accept and go on to verify, or one more round; does not start the verifier on its own
Does not edit code itself and does not run /pr-self-review
